weeks.label: trend
weeks.structural_note: Alpaca paper does not credit cash dividends while the shadow uses dividend-adjusted (adj_close) returns, so paper is EXPECTED to lag the shadow by roughly the portfolio's dividend yield over time. A negative cumulative divergence of that order is expected dividend drag, not tracking error.
